name: MoE-Sovereign-Scientific-Benchmark-v1
description: Rigorous multidisciplinary scientific benchmark comparing MoE-Sovereign Compound AI (Student 4B Planner on N04-RGTX + Sovereign-Judge 35B on N04-RTX + Qwen3.8:27B Experts + Full MCP Tooling + GraphRAG) vs. MoE-Sovereign Ablation (No GraphRAG) vs. Native Qwen3.8:27B Baseline.
author: Philipp Horn <kontakt@philipp-horn.dev>

test_cases.name: Lock-Free MPSC Ring Buffer with Memory Orderings
test_cases.description: Requires writing a production-grade multi-producer single-consumer lock-free ring buffer in Rust or C++11. Must correctly specify Acquire-Release semantics, handle buffer wrap-around via bitwise masking on power-of-two capacity, prevent false sharing with cacheline alignment (64 bytes), and include concurrent stress tests.
test_cases.prompt:
Implement a high-performance, bounded lock-free Multi-Producer Single-Consumer (MPSC) queue in Rust (or modern C++20). The implementation must satisfy:
1. Power-of-two capacity with bitwise index wrapping.
2. Strict atomic memory orderings (no sequential consistency std::memory_order_seq_cst overhead; use memory_order_acquire / memory_order_release / memory_order_relaxed explicitly where appropriate).
3. Cacheline padding (64 bytes / alignas(64)) to eliminate false sharing between producer tail and consumer head.
4. Safe handling of buffer full (backpressure/error) and buffer empty conditions without blocking or spin-lock deadlocks.
5. Provide a rigorous unit test demonstrating multi-threaded producer contention with a single consumer thread validating zero message loss and FIFO order per producer.

scoring.rubric: Code correctness, atomic memory ordering justification, cacheline alignment, and thorough concurrent test coverage.

test_cases.name: Linux eBPF XDP Packet Filter & Map Sync
test_cases.description: Requires constructing an eBPF XDP kernel program in C that parses IPv4 TCP packets, enforces dynamic rate-limiting via BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH, drops blacklisted CIDR blocks directly in the driver layer, and updates statistics in a per-CPU array map.
test_cases.prompt:
Write a complete Linux kernel eBPF program (C syntax with SEC("xdp")) for high-throughput packet filtering:
1. Parse Ethernet, IPv4, and TCP headers with strict eBPF verifier bounds checking (data + offset > data_end checks).
2. Look up the source IP in a BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH or BPF_MAP_TYPE_LRU_HASH blacklist map. If found, return XDP_DROP.
3. Track packet and byte counts in a BPF_MAP_TYPE_PERCPU_ARRAY map.
4. Forward non-matching traffic with XDP_PASS.
5. Explain how the BPF verifier ensures safety and why bounds checks are mandatory before every pointer dereference.

scoring.rubric: Strict adherence to eBPF verifier constraints, correct pointer validation, map definition syntax, and network header parsing.

test_cases.name: Multi-Turn Sovereign Microservices Dependency & Cascade Analysis
test_cases.description: Injects proprietary non-public infrastructure relations across Turns 1 & 2 into the knowledge graph, then queries a multi-hop cascading failure impact across 4 tiers in Turn 3. Measures the GraphRAG / Knowledge Graph preservation delta.

turns.prompt:
Persistent Architecture Registration: Cluster 'Apex-Central' runs the following topology:
- Gateway Service 'mcp-edge-gw' (Port 8443) routes authentication to 'auth-vault-01' (Port 9110) and telemetry to 'metrics-kafka-broker' (Port 9092).
- 'auth-vault-01' synchronously depends on 'valkey-session-primary' (Port 6379) for distributed token leases and asynchronously replicates audit records to 'neo4j-ledger-node' (Port 7687).
Store this relationship topology in the Sovereign Knowledge Graph.
turns.expected_behavior: Acknowledge receipt and persist entity nodes (mcp-edge-gw, auth-vault-01, valkey-session-primary, neo4j-ledger-node) and dependency edges.

turns.prompt: Topology Update & Quorum Policy: In 'Apex-Central', 'valkey-session-primary' requires a quorum heartbeat with 'valkey-sentinel-cluster' (Port 26379). If 'valkey-session-primary' loses quorum or fails, 'auth-vault-01' enters degraded fail-closed mode, which immediately blocks all new token issuance at 'mcp-edge-gw' while allowing existing cached JWT validation for up to 300 seconds.
turns.expected_behavior: Integrate failure mode policy and connect sentinel dependencies to session primary.

turns.prompt:
Incident Simulation: A network partition isolates 'valkey-sentinel-cluster' from 'valkey-session-primary' on Port 26379 for 450 seconds. Based on the persistent architecture in the Sovereign Knowledge Base:
1. Trace the exact cascading failure sequence step-by-step across all 5 affected services.
2. What is the operational state of 'mcp-edge-gw' at t=100s vs t=400s?
3. Which ports and database ledgers remain unaffected?
turns.expected_behavior: Synthesizes facts from Turn 1 and Turn 2: Explains quorum loss -> auth-vault-01 fail-closed -> t=100s cached JWT allowed, new issuance blocked -> t=400s cached JWT expired (>300s), full auth outage at mcp-edge-gw -> metrics-kafka-broker (Port 9092) and neo4j-ledger-node (Port 7687) remain structurally unaffected.

scoring.rubric: Accurate cross-turn synthesis of multi-hop dependency graph, precise timeline evaluation (100s vs 400s), and failure isolation.

test_cases.name: Temporal Rule Override & Contradiction Resolution
test_cases.description: Injects a legacy compliance rule and a newly amended sovereign governance constraint that partially contradicts it. Tests whether GraphRAG and paraconsistent logic correctly identify the timestamped override rather than hallucinating an invalid compromise.

turns.prompt: Archive Policy Record (Directive 2024-B): 'All sovereign LLM training logs containing prompt telemetry must be stored in encrypted S3 cold storage for 730 days before irreversible cryptographic erasure.'

Sovereign Executive Amendment (Directive 2026-S-Rev4, Effective Immediately): 'Section 4 amends Directive 2024-B: Prompt telemetry classified as Confidential-Enterprise or higher must be purged within 30 days. Only anonymized token routing metadata may be retained for 730 days in the local cold storage.'

Compliance Verification: An audit discovers raw prompt telemetry with user queries classified as 'Confidential-Enterprise' from 60 days ago stored in S3 cold storage. Under the current Sovereign governance rules, is this compliant, non-compliant, or grandfathered? Explain the exact legal/technical hierarchy between Directive 2024-B and Directive 2026-S-Rev4.
turns.expected_behavior: Determines NON-COMPLIANT under Directive 2026-S-Rev4 (30-day purge threshold exceeded); explains that the 2026 amendment supersedes the 2024 730-day rule for Confidential-Enterprise data.

scoring.rubric: Correct identification of non-compliance, resolution of temporal contradiction using the superseding amendment.

test_cases.name: Asymmetric VLSM IPv4 Partition & Broadcast Computation
test_cases.description: Requires calculating a multi-subnet VLSM partition of 10.180.0.0/19 into 4 custom subnets (1x 2000 hosts, 1x 1000 hosts, 2x 250 hosts). Verified against deterministic network math.
test_cases.prompt:
Perform an exact Variable Length Subnet Mask (VLSM) subnetting calculation for the network 10.180.0.0/19:
Subnet A: Needs 2,000 usable host addresses.
Subnet B: Needs 1,000 usable host addresses.
Subnet C: Needs 250 usable host addresses.
Subnet D: Needs 250 usable host addresses.

For each subnet (A, B, C, D), calculate and list:
1. Network ID with CIDR notation
2. Subnet Mask (dotted decimal)
3. First Usable Host IP
4. Last Usable Host IP
5. Broadcast Address
6. Total usable host count

scoring.rubric: Exact mathematical precision on network boundaries, masks, usable host ranges, and broadcast IPs.

test_cases.name: High-Precision Compounded Energy Cost & Carbon Offset Calculation
test_cases.description: Multi-step arithmetic involving kilowatt-hours, tiered electricity tariffs, inflation compounding over 3 years, and metric tons of CO2 offset.
test_cases.prompt:
Calculate the exact mathematical figures for the following datacenter expansion:
- Baseline load: 840 kW constant draw, 24 hours/day, 365 days/year.
- Base energy tariff: 0.1850 EUR/kWh in Year 1.
- Annual tariff escalation: +4.5% in Year 2 and +3.8% in Year 3.
- Grid emission intensity: 385 grams CO2 per kWh.

Calculate:
1. Total energy consumption in MWh per year.
2. Total electricity cost in EUR for Year 1, Year 2, and Year 3 (rounded to 2 decimal places).
3. 3-Year Cumulative Electricity Cost in EUR.
4. Total CO2 emissions across all 3 years in metric tonnes (t CO2).
Show exact step-by-step arithmetic.

test_cases.name: Raft Consensus Log Matching & Leader Invariant Proof
test_cases.description: Requires constructing a formal proof/reasoning chain for Raft's Leader Completeness and Log Matching Property under split-brain network partition scenarios.
test_cases.prompt:
Provide a rigorous formal reasoning proof for the Raft Consensus Algorithm:
Scenario: A 5-node Raft cluster (Nodes A, B, C, D, E) experiences a network partition separating {A, B} from {C, D, E}. Node A was the leader in Term 1.
1. Can {A, B} commit new log entries in Term 1? Prove why or why not using quorum intersection.
2. When Node C initiates an election in Term 2 within {C, D, E}, what invariant guarantees that Node C's log contains all committed entries from Term 1?
3. When the partition heals, how does the Log Matching Property resolve conflicting uncommitted entries in {A, B}? Specify the role of leader AppendEntries RPCs and term comparisons step-by-step.

scoring.rubric: Logical soundness, accurate application of quorum intersection theorems, and precise explanation of log truncation.

test_cases.name: Technical Sovereignty & Data Protection by Design Audit
test_cases.description: Evaluates a proposed healthcare compound AI architecture against technical sovereignty, air-gapping, model provenance, and cryptographic auditability without making unverified blanket compliance claims.
test_cases.prompt:
Evaluate an on-premises hospital compound AI architecture:
Components: Local SLMs (4B Planner, 35B Specialist), self-hosted Vector DB (ChromaDB), local GraphRAG (Neo4j), and a confidential inference enclave.
1. Identify the 4 critical technical prerequisites supporting Data Protection by Design and preventing unauthorized external telemetry exfiltration.
2. Formulate an auditable egress-filtering and cryptographic logging policy (using OpenLineage/Marquez and Kafka immutable logs).
3. Explain why this architectural pattern provides 'technical prerequisites for privacy and operational sovereignty' rather than a blanket legal certification.

scoring.rubric: Adherence to MoE Sovereign terminology (compiler of workflows, technical prerequisites, no blanket legal claims), rigorous security controls.
